comment:
* Helper class for monitoring the state of packages: adding, removing,
 * updating, and disappearing and reappearing on the SD card.

variables.name: mRegisteredContext
variables.comment: unset when we want to unregister.

methods.name: public void register(@NonNull Context context, @Nullable Looper thread, @Nullable UserHandle user)
methods.comment:
* To register the intents that needed for monitoring the state of packages. Once this method
     * has been called on an instance of {@link PackageChangeReceiver}, all subsequent calls must
     * have the same {@code user} argument.

methods.name: public void unregister()
methods.comment: * To unregister the intents for monitoring the state of packages

methods.name: public void onPackageAdded(@Nullable String packageName)
methods.comment: * This method is invoked when receive the Intent.ACTION_PACKAGE_ADDED

methods.name: public void onPackageRemoved(@Nullable String packageName)
methods.comment: * This method is invoked when receive the Intent.ACTION_PACKAGE_REMOVED

methods.name: public void onPackageUpdateFinished(@Nullable String packageName)
methods.comment: * This method is invoked when Intent.EXTRA_REPLACING as extra field is true

methods.name: public void onPackageModified(@Nullable String packageName)
methods.comment:
* This method is invoked when receive the Intent.ACTION_PACKAGE_CHANGED or
     * Intent.EXTRA_REPLACING as extra field is true

methods.name: public void onHandleForceStop(@Nullable String[] packages, boolean doit)
methods.comment:
* This method is invoked when receive the Intent.ACTION_QUERY_PACKAGE_RESTART and
     * Intent.ACTION_PACKAGE_RESTARTED

methods.name: public void onPackageDisappeared()
methods.comment: * This method is invoked when receive the Intent.ACTION_PACKAGE_REMOVED

methods.name: public void onPackageAppeared()
methods.comment: * This method is invoked when receive the Intent.ACTION_PACKAGE_ADDED

methods.name: public void onReceive(@Nullable Context context, @Nullable Intent intent)

methodNames: public void register(@NonNull Context context, @Nullable Looper thread, @Nullable UserHandle user)
public void onHandleForceStop(@Nullable String[] packages, boolean doit)
public void onReceive(@Nullable Context context, @Nullable Intent intent)
